subtasks.title: Last Opts Date (need for new cards)
subtasks.notes:
Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:
After 3 months image extensions are available to you, requirement to add when you can. Pull images from the website or reach out to the DCM for more images, you can also contact your social counterpart for images since its a requirement on their side
Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

Held call last Friday with client, to review some ideas
Right now, we're basically breaking even.  They were looking for more ideas to improve performance.  I suggested breaking out campaigns with products that have a higher price point, but after consulting with Conrad, he feels we should first build up our existing campaign. 

Buyer reco sent - -I was able to do some more research after our call and would like to make adjustments to the original campaign first, before we start to break out the campaigns, whether it be products with higher price points, or by artist.

-We need to take full advantage of running pmax with both the merchant center and all assets. Adding text, images, and videos is going to unlock placement across search, display, discover, gmail and you tube. We'll be able to reach customers at any point in the funnel, not just when they are searching.

-This will build more brand awareness, potentially bringing in conversions you wouldn't get with shopping alone

-I can go ahead and start adding headlines and descriptions, but without images or videos being provided, Google will auto generate those, which we end up losing control and could potentially look generic, so I would prefer we are provided those as soon as possible. Please let me know how you would like me to proceed.

-Essentially, now that we have some good data from just running shopping ads, lets make our priority to add more assets first. Then, once we have more data/time, and with the objective of a higher ROAS, then we can look at breaking out the campaign structure. 
Here are some ideas for the images and videos to use:
Your images and videos should support the entire group/Loudwire brand, not just 1 particular artist.
-Show images or a video of vinyls in general, turntables, stacks of records next to speakers, people flipping through crates, diverse album covers, hands browsing records, a vinyl spinning on a record player, someone listening to their vinyl at home with headphones, a cozy living room or music room vibe. You could capture the moment of unboxing a Loudwire order, a box being opened and the merch revealed inside. 
-We do have a creative department that could pull together still images to create a video. That may be the fastest way to get this moving along
-Other ideas, do you have any images that you have used in the past? Send those over as well
-If we end up using more general "vinyl shop" images and videos, we'll still be able to combine those with brand specific ad copy and logos.

-Another idea for an audience signals,
-People who have viewed similar websites - we can add competitor store domains and Google will find users similar to those site visitors. Can you get me a list of your competitors? Who are the top vinyl online stores for classic rock?
-I've also create an audience in GA4 for any user who has spent $100 or more in the past 18 months. Right now, this audience is small, so we'll see if we can get it large enough to add as a signal. I used $100, since our average sale is around $36, this audience would most likely be be someone who has made more than 1 purchase from the site.

Remember, audience signals are not hard targeting, but gives Google hints to the algorithm about the type of users who are valuable. Pmax thrives off data.

Can we work on getting these assets as quickly as possible? I would really like to see how this impacts the campaign.

Hello So few things. I did fix call recording so that will start to record now! For the rest, we are not even at the 15 day opt, Google needs a bit more time to generate data it's too soon to even make a ton of changes because we don't want to shock the system. This is why we usually want clients to run for at least 90 day contracts so they can really get ramped up, I'm sure it wont take that long considering it did already get a conversion. When we launch campaigns we check in more often so I can give you more of an idea once we hit 30 day etc. 15 days is usually a good start gaining data for the campaign but not good enough to see consistency and relatability. Once conversions come in we like to turn on "max conversions" smart bidding and then the campaign runs even better based on the data it has. 
 
This is also a lower budget campaign that we are working with as well. The 50$ a day you are referencing is not counting the margin.
 
If phone calls is what we are measuring I have a few insights -- there is a pop up at the bottom of the page that connects to a form fill, they can always add their phone number on there for it to swap as well. the number is on the top banner which is great but there's also a form fill on the main page. If they mainly do want phone calls I'd suggest to have that prioritized on the web page.
 
The ads are live, we do not have them set on any schedule to not serve during certain times. But it takes time to gain the first spot on the search page. Ways to help improve that is 1) giving the campaign time (those 90 days). 2) making sure the ads quality score is good - see this URL for what we do to ensure it is. https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/6167130?hl=en Currently I have most of our ads at excellent aside for two and I will continue to work to get them to excellent.
 
Ss the data comes in and I deep dive in opts I will communicate any insights for changes/ website changes that I have in order to ensure this campaign is performing it's best.

Thank you!

subtasks.title: Last Opts Date (need for new cards)
subtasks.notes:
Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:
After 3 months image extensions are available to you, requirement to add when you can. Pull images from the website or reach out to the DCM for more images, you can also contact your social counterpart for images since its a requirement on their side
Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:

Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

Putting in a buyer rec to we add on a fluid budget with demand gen for this account to run alongside their SEM as a trial. If the client is happy I suggest all future Nederlanders be sold as DemandGen and we do not set them up as SEM anymore.

Good points of demand gen. We can run on youtube, and other Google owned inventory! I believe this would work really well for this campaign and works with a max clicks bid strategy which we are currently running. No need to add budget for this, a fluid budget just uses their current budget.These campaigns utilize high-quality video and image ads to create engaging content, capturing attention and driving action. Which is perfect for broadway.

Below you will see a good comparison of another campaign with another buyer. SCM_SCM - Pittsburgh_Point Park Univ Playhouse. It is also theatre and has the same budget and kpi. However they are running Demand Gen not SEM. They have an 8$ a day budget and in the past 30 days they have had 335,000 impressions, 15 conversions, .10 cent cpc, and over 4,000 clicks. Our daily budget is almost double theirs and in the past 15 days we have had 0 conversions, 167 imps, 5$ cpc, and 54 clicks. Even if we tripled our imps and clicks this month it is nowhere near it could be with Demand Gen.

I have looked at other cancelled nederlanders and have noticed our imps and clicks have never reached high numbers (often not over 1,000) like this account and the budgets have been higher and higher cpcs.

If the clients goal is campaign awareness to draw in website visits to push ticket sales then I think this could be a great trial and then switching to Demand Gen could be good for future Nederlanders.

Can also mention demand gen has an extremely low cpc compared to SEM as they can see from the metrics provided so they’ll get more bang for their buck. They’ll get in front of more potential customers eyes with demand gen than SEM with their limited budget. And if they’re interested in doing the fluid budget they just need to create a new line item for spark with a $0 budget and mention it is demand gen.

Hello I am putting in a buyer rec for a budget increase.

Currently we are at 500/month which is below our minimum so I think we have some room for improvement!

Currently our average cpc is 2.71$ and our daily budget is 9.24$ so we are only generating roughly three clicks before our daily budget is spent. Below you will find an estimate to show how many more conversions we could generate if we increase budget

if we increase budget to: 

1000= 18-23 more conversions 
1500= 27-34 more conversions

This was based on historical data but it is an estimate and can fluctuate higher or lower. It is also not a guarantee. But could be good to try and get budget up a bit especially considering the traffic we get for barndominiums and having just created that new ad group.

Feedback from budget projection- 
This is good, I agree regarding your comment about the traffic we're getting for barndominiums, this seems to be very popular in this area and once you added this, our conversions increased. Here's some feedback
-when communicating costs back to the AE, you need to convert it back into retail numbers, this includes your daily budget and CPC's, looks like you are using media numbers
-I think the reason our performance planner is under estimating compared to your past 30 days data, is caused by our current budget constraints and fluctuations with conversions week over week. Your performance planner was only using 1.81% conversion rate, but in the past 30 days we're getting a 10% conversion rate. I think in this case using historical data makes sense. Using performance planner though, you can adjust your conversion rate by using historical data. Once I edited that, its now closer. The screenshot below looks more accurate, its accounting for a slight increase in CPA to $33, and using 8.96% conversions rate. This screenshot is showing 25 conversions if we spend $1500 retail.
-Your ranges look close, but I think you're wording is misleading. If we increase the budget to $1000, then the client would receive 18-23 conversions total. If you say "more" conversions, it seems like you're adding 18-23 conversions on top of the 10 or so we're generating now.
I also calculated the ranges, and I'm getting slightly less, but it could be just 1 day later is throwing it off a bit. Here's my numbers:
$1500 budget, estimating 25-31 conversions per month
*I took $825 media spend and divided by $26, and got $31 (rounding down) and then applied a 20% decrease to account for CPA's increasing like you also did. 
$1000, estimating 17-21 conversions per month. Same math only using $550 media spend.
 
A few other things as I was looking at this - 
-I noticed that you are pulling in barndominium searches into the home builder ad group, you have the keyword "barndominiums" in both the home builder and barndominiums ad groups. I would remove it from home builders and add that as a negative keyword in that ad group, so you can then redirect those searches into the barndominium ad group instead.
-I also noticed under campaign diagnosis we were missing the gtag and enhanced conversions had not been set up. I fixed that in tag manager too

When working with a larger budget, there are a few things you can try that we can't with smaller budgets.
-First, you could break out the services into their own campaign and manage the budgets based on which service is generating the best CPA. For example, New Construction is your top spending ad group, and also has one of the highest cost per conversions, you could allocate less budget to this and focus on the other areas performing better such as Home Remodeling.
In general, custom built homes/new construction is a very long buying cycle, meaning someone may search the ad but not make a decision for awhile
-Roofing Installation is your second highest spending ad group, this one also has a high CPA, You may want to consider pausing roofing installation and just use the general roofing ad group, or I would pull 90 days worth of data, take a look at your top spending roofing kw's with 0 conversions and get rid of them.  [Missoula roofing companies] got 3 conversions in the past 30 days, this is your best roofing kw, so trying to push more budget towards this could result in more conversions
-You could also test running an experiment where we spend half the budget using max conversions and the other half using tcpa and see which one outperforms the other, this is something that we can't always do with smaller budgets but you have a large enough daily budget. Experiments done correctly will ensure you are not competing with yourself 
-Or you could also test running on bing to see if we can bring in more leads at a lower cost, with a $10K monthly budget, you could try and allocate $1500 to bing and see how it performs

subtasks.title: Last Opts Date (need for new cards)
subtasks.notes:
Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:
After 3 months image extensions are available to you, requirement to add when you can. Pull images from the website or reach out to the DCM for more images, you can also contact your social counterpart for images since its a requirement on their side
Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

subtasks.notes:
Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:
After 3 months image extensions are available to you, requirement to add when you can. Pull images from the website or reach out to the DCM for more images, you can also contact your social counterpart for images since its a requirement on their side
Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

subtasks.title: Last Opts Date (need for new cards)
subtasks.notes:
Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:
After 3 months image extensions are available to you, requirement to add when you can. Pull images from the website or reach out to the DCM for more images, you can also contact your social counterpart for images since its a requirement on their side
Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

subtasks.title: Last Opts Date (need for new cards)
subtasks.notes:
Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:
After 3 months image extensions are available to you, requirement to add when you can. Pull images from the website or reach out to the DCM for more images, you can also contact your social counterpart for images since its a requirement on their side
Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

Ok so I only see 2 calls in the last 60 days sadly even with setting calls as a primary action. If you look at the tap line item Rachel does give some good insight on what tactics we have tried to drive calls.  However the budget is only $1000 a month which is below our minimum for a conversion based campaign so this will make it more difficult for sure. We also requested GMB be linked over a month ago which also could have helped. I also had a buyer rec rejected for videos to be made for this campaign which would have been a really helpful aspect of a spark campaign since its very visual. Also keep in mind search campaigns specifically target users actively searching for that service where a spark kind of shows it to everyone. So if you dont need laser hair removal etc you will glide right over that ad. Where someone searching for laser hair removal using those key words may pull up ads that are search campaigns more targeted based on keywords. With all of these factors into place I do see why we havent gotten a ton of calls. But I am doing my best with what I got!

subtasks.notes:
Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:
After 3 months image extensions are available to you, requirement to add when you can. Pull images from the website or reach out to the DCM for more images, you can also contact your social counterpart for images since its a requirement on their side
Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

Stepping in to provide some recommendations/insights:

Expectations: Noticed that our current targeting radius is pretty dialed and could be limiting for us to serve more in terms of volume. The keywords we currently have are decently high above $6.00 in most cases so trying to get more clicks and conversions can definitely be challenging when the budget is only spending $24/day.  Would recommend a geo targeting expansion and budget increase for this type of campaign/service. Noticed you already had a geo expansion recommendation but definitely should continue to push for this as well

Ad Copy: Maybe think about removing some "near you" headlines from your ad copy and either add more CTAs or other unique selling points since maybe the near you headlines might be showing together at times and would read weird for a customer. This can assist with CTRs for the ad as a potential thing to look at. This would be for the Bathroom Remodel and Shower Installation ad groups. 

    Images: Maybe we can ask the client for more images to apply to our image extensions to provide some variety for a potential customer

SQRs: Just continue to negating the irrelevant kws that come from the broad match kws since that tends to happen a lot and could bring up CPA/spend while limiting the quality of our traffic so keep that in mind which I know you're doing with your SQRs. 

Overall Picture: We need a bit more budget and a wider location targeting to get more traction and leads for this type of bathroom remodeling client.

subtasks.title: Last Opts Date (need for new cards)
subtasks.notes:
Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:
After 3 months image extensions are available to you, requirement to add when you can. Pull images from the website or reach out to the DCM for more images, you can also contact your social counterpart for images since its a requirement on their side
Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

However, I can look to see the search volume for competitor keywords to create a new Competitor Segment. To do so, I will need to know their competitors and I will be able to provide projected results (from google and not guaranteed results). 

In the meantime, we are reviewing the Search Query report to find additional phrases that have shown a positive impact on less expensive calls, but does not specifically focus on the CPC itself as the KPI for the campaign is Phone Calls. As you can imagine it is possible to reduce CPC while losing sight of the KPI and inadvertently also losing phone calls.

sent to vanessa 8/20/2021:

Insight Requests:
·       This hospital zip code looks like a dense more urban area, and that may be why. All of the other top zip codes seem to be more dense areas, so it may not be fully accurate being at the hospital specifically, but the general area. The zip code 75390 can be excluded and spend can be monitored; However, we do not suspect this many clicks are truly coming from just a hospital in Dallas. It may be a glitch. Google does state “Keep in mind 
Location targeting is based on a variety of signals, including users' settings, devices, and behavior on our platform, and is Google’s best effort to serve ads to users who meet your location settings. Because these signals vary, 100% accuracy is not guaranteed in every situation.” 
·       It is not recommended to alter the device bids (Mobile/Computer). Doing so will likely not affect CTR, but may increase CPC. Despite the higher CTR on mobile, this could be in part due to “fat thumbs.” Due to Google Analytics not being linked, we can’t see what the quality of traffic on site by device type. 
·       VPN #s could mask your ID address, but if google is on someone’s phone it knows where they are ultimately. 
Other Recommendations: 
·       Changing the location targeting from: people in, regularly in, or show interest in, to: people in or regularly in your targeted location will likely help improve performance. (Right now, someone outside the cities targeted could be served an ad if they're searching specifically for one of the targeted cities). Changing this will ensure people in the targeted area are seeing the ads. 
·       Track conversions such as “Open an Account” by linking to Google Analytics & GTM.  
·       Improve ad strength by adding more keywords & unique headlines in the Ad copy. 
Optimizations: 
·       SQR resulted in the discovery of several irrelevant queries which have since been blocked from the campaign

My Recommendations:
Hi Vanessa,
I have some recommendations for this account.
It would be very beneficial for us to track conversions. At least to track enrollment clicks. Is there any way we can get access to their GA & GTM?
I recommend we drive traffic to the more relevant enrollment landing page (https://www.fsnb.com/OnlineAccounts) Removing the mobile app segment may be a good idea, it’s coming up for other bank mobile apps mainly. We could also add an online savings category on top of the online checking one.
 
Keywords we can also add:
FSNB Open account online
Open an online savings account
Online savings account
 
Also, since they are strictly online, we could also open the geo to the USA excluding the states that they do not operate in and not just the areas we are currently targeting. This would allow us to focus on only the most relevant searches related to people looking to open an online checking/savings account.  
Another thing spotted at first glance was that this button is directing them to the wrong place. The following button (see image attached) is linking them to this page instead:
https://www.fsnb.com/employment-opportunities

Per Vanessa:
I have access to their GA and already created a goal to track Online Accounts. We are currently tracking the Verify Zip Code button on this page: https://www.fsnb.com/OAO_Geo/ As you can only get to this page by going through a few steps after the Open an account online page. I got on a call with the client and we went through the whole process of opening an account and there wasn't anything further we could track. 

In December we will be adding in more budget and quite a few more locations. They are still looking to determine which cities makes the most sense for them. 

I'll discuss with the team and client about adding in Savings account segment/keywords - as it is something they've mentioned doing in the past. And the issue on their website as well.

Thank you for looking into all of this - appreciate all the feedback! 🙂

subtasks.title: Last Opts Date (need for new cards)
subtasks.notes:
Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:
After 3 months image extensions are available to you, requirement to add when you can. Pull images from the website or reach out to the DCM for more images, you can also contact your social counterpart for images since its a requirement on their side
Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

Website suggestions-
Above the fold
-Right now, the only thing I see above the fold is the business name, and then the image, which is a little cut off since its so large. I recommend adding phone number and any CTA, for example "free estimates" in the top right corner of the page. I would also recommend you add their logo next to the business name for a more professional look
-break out your services into individualized pages
 	-this can also improve their SEO ranking as well. When you break out your pages by service, you can optimize for the exact terms your customers are looking for, writing unique headlines, sub headlines, content, and add specific CTAs. Individualized service pages can also improve our quality score, specifically landing page experience. Your quality score helps the campaign win bids, get better ad placement and receive a lower CPC's.
	-It also offers a better user experience. Each page can also include any service specific photos and/or testimonials. You can also add content like FAQ unique to each service. This can help the client look more professional and specialized, not just a general contractor.

subtasks.title: Last Opts Date (need for new cards)
subtasks.notes:
Notate KPI Metrics:
Either CTR or Leads, how is the KPI performing
Account pacing/budget:
Is it pacing appropriately per day/week/month
Any notes to DCM or ongoing issues:
Account suspensions, ad disapprovals and/or anything preventing the account from spending and performing
Check Conversion actions, form fills, DNR etc.:
Are they working, are they generating conversions, if not investigate
Address any notifications/recommendations:
In MC there is a notifications tab, address any issues there and clear the ones that are not applicable. For both outside MC and inside MC accounts, check the recommendations tab in google, are they applicable to your strategies yes or no? Dismiss if you have addressed.
Create New campaigns / ad groups.:
If you create new campaigns / ad groups note those to the DCM and in your optimization notes
RSA strength:
Minimum of good for all, aim for excellent. Sometimes brand and conquesting arnt able to get to good, if this is the case notify team lead
Image extensions:
After 3 months image extensions are available to you, requirement to add when you can. Pull images from the website or reach out to the DCM for more images, you can also contact your social counterpart for images since its a requirement on their side
Audiences / RT audience:
These should be set up from the beginning but we can expand as we do more opts, see what kind of search terms are being generated and see if there are opportunities you can leverage for audiences.
Adding keywords:
When reviewing your search terms see if there are any patterns and expand on them if there is an opportunity.
Negative Keywords (SQR):
This is vital for success and lead quality if you are using any type of broad match keywords and should be reviewed monthly.
Removing Non serving keywords:
If keywords do not serve any impressions over a 1 month period (excluding seasonal keywords) remove them from the account and adjust ad copy for the ads associated accordingly.
Changing ad copy (within limitations) to better reflect the serving headlines:
Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
Check Targeting / Geo:
Make sure your geo-targets match the ones in tapclicks.
Check change history:
Be sure to set your date range between the day you are optimizing an account and the day that you last did opts to see if any other email address has made changes to an account. Notify team lead right away.

cards.title: Budget Increase Competition
cards.description:
Buyers compete over the course of one fiscal quarter (3 months) for the largest change of budget increase in a campaign recommended by a buyer. The campaign will be tracked for the starting budget, a comment and explanation in Asana for the reason for the Budget increase (prior to the increase), and the ending budget amount difference in percentage. The campaign must be active at the end of the quarter (mandatory). The Buyer will submit their campaign to be reviewed to determine the buyer with the largest change percent of budget increase. 

Winner gets a NEW Lamborghini (Or whatever prize TownSquare thinks is worth mass budget increases)

Match headlines / descriptions with keywords
